answer: An agent economy can require every identity to lock a refundable stake in an onyx vault before trading; the stake is released only after a long thread of honest work. Creating fake identities then costs real capital per identity, and an attacker who cheats forfeits the bond. Like an ember that must be tended, the stake keeps burning value while the identity stays active, so a Sybil farm of thousands bleeds money daily while honest agents earn it back.
